rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; Form 8960 (2025) line 1, "Taxable interest (see instructions)" (the line 1 instructions are not among the pages given, as the model notes). Form 1040 line 2b copies Schedule B line 4, which is line 2 less line 3, and line 3 is zero because the Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported; the floor at zero is a type wrapper. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 142 partial records; 2,024 comparisons per line; record triage/f8960.json)): 1,780 agree; no value difference; 35 project-refuses on the cited screens on the line (f8960.refund 18, f8960.unsupported, whose BUG-0248 gloss ("a disposition adjustment (Form 8960 line 5b or 5c, for example gain on employer securities attributable to net unrealized appreciation (NUA) from a qualified plan, or the sale of property held in a trade or business or of an interest in a partnership or S corporation)") matches i8960 p. 9, Line 5b ("Gain attributable to net unrealized appreciation (NUA) in employer securities held by a qualified plan"; "Gain or loss from the sale of property held in a non-section 1411 trade or business") and only widens the refusal (it names any trade or business, where p. 9 says non-section 1411; business income is refused by the same screen anyway), 17; e.g. classm.f8889.5.deepseek, classm.person.1.deepseek) and 209 project-unknown with those screens withheld (169 f8960.unsupported, 40 f8960.refund; e.g. table.band.first, tcw.mfs.b1); none on a completed return. Project stands.

Ruling: scope; i8960 p. 22, Line 13: "If you didn't exclude any amounts from your gross income under section 911 and you don't own an interest in a CFC or PFIC, your MAGI is your AGI as reported on Form 1040 or 1040-SR." Form 1040 line 11b copies line 11a, so the candidate's line 11a is the same AGI; section 911 and CFC/PFIC cases are refused by f8960.unsupported. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 142 partial records; 2,024 comparisons per line; record triage/f8960.json)): 1,974 agree; 11 project-refuses on the cited f8960.refund screen (classm.person.1.deepseek, classm.f5695.7), 37 project-unknown with it withheld, and 2 candidate-refuses on upstream screens (sa.excluded_income, sales[s1].digital) reached on partial records where the project stops at the withheld f8960.refund (classm.f8889.5.deepseek, classm.asset.2), both refused returns. No value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; Form 8960 (2025) line 2, "Ordinary dividends (see instructions)". Form 1040 line 3b copies Schedule B line 6, the project's reference. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,382 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 142 partial records; 2,024 comparisons per line; record triage/f8960.json)): all 2,024 agree. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Both read line 9b as the state, local and foreign income tax allocable to net investment income, allowed only when itemizing. The second transcription caps the allocation at Schedule A line 5e; the project takes the supplied allocation and refuses the return through `f8960.bad_allocation` when the claimed allocation exceeds the Schedule A deduction, so within the non-refused scope the values agree. No change to the data.
